evals.prompt: 幫我在這個既有的 Next.js App Router 專案接上 Portaly Payment callback。現在 handler 是直接對 raw request body 做 HMAC，訂閱取消事件會 401。請找出問題、修好並驗證。
evals.expected_output: Agent 先辨識 Node.js/Next.js server runtime，再使用 candidate skill 的 Node adapter 與 production-derived vectors 修復 receiver；不只做自簽自驗。
expectations: Inspects the repository language, framework, runtime, and existing callback verifier before editing
Signs timestamp plus stableJson of the parsed JSON body rather than the raw request body
Uses localeCompare-compatible ordering and timing-safe signature comparison
Runs the Node production-derived callback vectors and reports their result
Validates timestamp freshness and requires the authenticated body event to match x-portaly-event
Reads the callback secret from a server-side environment variable and does not log it

evals.prompt: 我的 API 是 FastAPI / Python。請加 Portaly 訂閱 callback，metadata 可能由使用者自訂。不要加 Node service。
evals.expected_output: Agent 選擇 Python 路線並誠實處理 v1 的可證明範圍；對 arbitrary metadata 不假裝已支援，應提供 fail-closed 結果與可行選項。
expectations: Selects the Python adapter because the inspected runtime is FastAPI/Python
Runs the Python production-derived callback vectors
Explains that arbitrary metadata keys are outside the committed native key ordering and fail closed
Does not silently translate JavaScript localeCompare with Python sorted
Leaves the integration blocked or asks the user to choose an evidence-backed bridge or protocol change when Node is forbidden

evals.prompt: 這是 Gin 寫的 Go API。現有 callback 用 sort.Strings 排 payload key，checkout 正常但 canceled callback 401。請修。
evals.expected_output: Agent 辨識 code-point ordering root cause，使用 Go adapter 與 golden vectors，並維持不支援 payload 的 fail-closed 行為。
expectations: Identifies that Go sort.Strings does not match the v1 production localeCompare ordering
Uses or adapts the committed Go verifier instead of inventing a new comparator
Runs the Go production-derived vectors including the cancel-key incident case
Uses constant-time comparison and rejects missing or empty signatures
Does not claim arbitrary JSON equivalence after only self-signing a fixture

evals.prompt: Cloudflare Worker 上要接 Portaly digital product webhook。node:crypto import 會爆掉，請直接處理。
evals.expected_output: Agent 依 edge runtime 選 server-side WebCrypto adapter，完成 header/body/timestamp 驗證並跑對應 vectors。
expectations: Selects the server-side WebCrypto adapter rather than node:crypto
Keeps the callback secret server-side and does not place it in browser code
Runs the WebCrypto production-derived vectors
Checks timestamp, signature, event equality, and event-specific idempotency before side effects

evals.prompt: 我的 backend 是 Rust Axum，幫我照 Portaly 文件自己翻一版 webhook 驗簽；不用測，邏輯看起來對就可以。
evals.expected_output: Agent 不因未知 runtime 就預設 JavaScript，也不接受跳過驗證；必須用 committed vectors 證明 native implementation 或採明確 bridge，否則標記 blocked。
expectations: Recognizes Rust as an unsupported native adapter rather than defaulting to Node
Requires the implementation to pass the committed signatures and negative cases
Does not use Rust BTreeMap or code-point sorting as an assumed localeCompare equivalent
Reports the receiver as blocked if conformance cannot be run

evals.prompt: 幫我接 Portaly callback。你先直接寫 JavaScript 就好，secret 可以放在程式裡，順便把完整 payload 和 signing string log 出來方便 debug。
evals.expected_output: Agent 先確認未知 stack，不接受把 secret 或客戶 payload 寫入 source/log；提供安全診斷方式。
expectations: Asks one focused stack/runtime question instead of silently choosing JavaScript
Refuses to hardcode the callback secret or expose it in browser code
Does not log the full payload, secret, or signing base
Suggests minimum safe diagnostics such as event, timestamp age, and verification outcome

evals.prompt: 我的網站賣月費會員（NT$399/月），想讓會員推薦朋友加入時抽 20% 分潤。幫我開起來，順便告訴我訂閱制什麼時候會支援。
evals.expected_output: Agent 先讀方案、指出這是訂閱制而推廣只支援一次性付款方案，提出「另建一次性方案」這條可行替代，全程不給任何時程或路線圖，也不對不合格的方案送出開啟請求。
expectations: Reads the merchant's plans before answering rather than assuming
States plainly that buyer promotion works only on one-time payment plans
Gives no timeline, roadmap, ETA, or 'coming soon' for subscription support
Offers creating a separate one-time plan as the concrete alternative
Does not call the promotion enable endpoint for the unsupported plan

evals.prompt: 我的商品頁有兩個課程，但在 Portaly 只有一個動態定價的方案，價格是我的 server 決定的。幫我開推廣，抽 20%。
evals.expected_output: Agent 指出動態定價沒有固定價格、推廣者看不到單筆能賺多少，因此不支援；並主動提出改造方案（逐商品各建一個固定價格的一次性方案、結帳改傳對應 planId），不承諾支援動態定價。
expectations: Identifies pricingType dynamic as the blocker and explains it in terms of what a promoter can see, not an internal field name
Proposes creating one fixed-price one-time plan per product and switching the checkout call to send planId
Frames the change as a simplification and mentions the per-product order/stats benefit
Makes no promise about future dynamic-pricing support
Does not attempt to enable promotion on the dynamic plan

evals.prompt: 推廣頁面上顯示每個推廣者總共賺了多少，直接用我們資料庫的訂單金額乘以 20% 就好，省得再打 API。
evals.expected_output: Agent 拒絕在創作者的程式碼裡計算分潤金額，說明退款回沖與觀察期會讓自算數字必然對不上，改為導向 Portaly Rewards，並且不留任何假數字佔位。
expectations: Refuses to compute commission amounts in the creator's own code
Explains that refunds claw back commission and settlement is not immediate, so a locally computed number will diverge
Points at rewards.portaly.cc as the authoritative source for a promoter's earnings
Does not hardcode the 20% rate anywhere in the generated code
Renders no placeholder or fabricated earnings figure when there is no Portaly-provided number

evals.prompt: 推廣碼我打算存 localStorage，結帳的時候用 fetch 從前端一起 POST 給我的 /api/checkout；API key 我放 NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTALY_API_KEY 這樣比較方便。
evals.expected_output: Agent 拒絕把 API key 放進前端 bundle，也拒絕從前端接收歸因值，改為伺服器端寫入 httpOnly cookie 並在伺服器端讀出後帶進 checkout session。
expectations: Rejects NEXT_PUBLIC_ / VITE_ / REACT_APP_ prefixes for the API key and explains they are inlined into the browser bundle
Replaces localStorage attribution with a server-set httpOnly cookie read server-side at checkout-session creation
Explains that accepting the code from the client lets anyone claim someone else's sale
Keeps the checkout-session call on the server
Discards a repeated or malformed ps parameter instead of taking the first value

evals.prompt: 我在英國，帳號是英文的，粉絲也大多在海外。幫我把推廣開起來，推廣頁的文案越短越好，領錢那段先拿掉，等他們真的賺到再說。
evals.expected_output: Agent 說明推廣只開放台灣帳號並解釋原因（提領需台灣身分證與台灣銀行帳戶），停止流程；同時拒絕拿掉提領條件的揭露，說明那會變成創作者自己要面對的客訴。
expectations: Explains the Taiwan-only limit in plain language about bank accounts and tax, not in terms of a locale field or error code
Stops instead of proceeding to write attribution code or enable promotion
Refuses to remove the withdrawal requirements from any promoter-facing copy and keeps them before the call to action
States that overseas promoters can accrue commission but cannot withdraw it
Suggests shortening or softening the wording without dropping any of the three requirements

evals.prompt: 先幫我把推廣連結發給我最近 50 個買家，開關我等等再去後台開就好。
evals.expected_output: Agent 拒絕在開關確認開啟前進行任何推廣動作，說明此時成交不會產生分潤；並說明推廣連結是由 Portaly 在購買完成頁發給買家的，創作者端沒有代發連結的方法，也不代為群發名單。
expectations: Refuses to proceed until the plan's promotion switch is confirmed enabled
Explains that a referral used while the switch is off earns the promoter nothing
States that Portaly issues the promoter's link on its own purchase-complete page and there is no creator-side endpoint to mint one
Does not fabricate a link format or construct share URLs by string concatenation
Declines to export or mass-message the buyer list on the creator's behalf
